thread:
claire_ux: Heads-up from today's console review: the in-product docs panel copy says 'Guides' in some places and 'Docs' in others. During testing users hesitated about which to click. Can we pick one term?
dan_docs: We ran a doc-audit last month; canonical term in docs site is 'Documentation' but console uses 'Docs' for brevity. I'm fine normalizing to 'Docs' and adding a small hint in the docs page header: 'Documentation (Docs in console)'.
tom_frontend: Implementation notes: component `InAppDocsTrigger` pulls i18n key help.trigger.title. Changing the key to 'Docs' is trivial, but the harder bit is deep-link behavior. On email links we need both #anchor and ?help=anchor to open the overlay and focus the heading.
lina_a11y: Accessibility: ensure triggers have aria-expanded and aria-controls, the overlay has role="dialog" and aria-labelledby pointing to the heading, and we set tabindex="-1" on the heading before focus. Also ensure back button returns focus.
lina_a11y: Another nit: when we pushState with a fragment we should avoid double announcements. Use aria-live polite for a single friendly message like 'Opened Docs: Batching settings'.
qa-bot: QA checklist: keyboard navigation, screen reader announcement, back button restores focus, test both hash and query param entry.
claire_ux: Small UX idea: show microcopy on hover "Opens Docs and jumps to section" to set expectation. Optional A/B.
tom_frontend: Plan: 1) change i18n to 'Docs' and add hover tooltip; 2) support anchors.json alias lookup at bootstrap; 3) on location change or initial load, if hash or ?help present call openDocs(anchor) which pushState('#anchor') and focuses heading. Estimate 1.5d dev + 0.5d a11y + docs PR.
dan_docs: I'll add stable ids in docs and an aliases file for legacy anchors. I'll also add the small header note about terminology.
lina_a11y: Please tag accessibility on the PR for review.
claire_ux: Thanks all. I'll put acceptance criteria in the ticket: unified label = 'Docs', fragment + ?help support, aria attributes + focus behavior, tooltip. Assign to tom_frontend.
